usage: aw [-h] [--version] [--home HOME] [--workspace WORKSPACE]
          {call,serve,setup,mcp,session,workspace,agent,maintenance,checkpoint,work,message,runtime,bridge,asset}
          ...

Persistent agents, explicit handoff, Git collaboration.

positional arguments:
  {call,serve,setup,mcp,session,workspace,agent,maintenance,checkpoint,work,message,runtime,bridge,asset}
    call                Invoke the same JSON operation used by HTTP/MCP.
    serve               Local workbench and authenticated HTTP tools.
    setup               Open first-use setup; detect dependencies, never
                        install them.
    mcp                 MCP stdio tools; use AW_* environment to bind model
                        identity.

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --version             show program's version number and exit
  --home HOME
  --workspace WORKSPACE, -w WORKSPACE
